item.title: Elly Tombarge Recognized For Her Artwork
item.description: VALLEY CITY, N.D. (NewsDakota.com) Valley City High School student Elly Tombarge placed 2nd in the NDSBA Holiday Art Contest. Tombarge received a $25 Amazon Gift Card. Her teacher, Mrs. Stephani Krueger will receive a $100 classroom donation.

item.title: Jamestown Recycling Collection Issues
item.description: JAMESTOWN, N.D. (NewsDakota.com) – Due to equipment issues, recycling collections will be delayed, December 11, 2025. Leave recycling containers out until collected as the Recycling Center of North Dakota’s crew will be working on routes until dark.
